title: CI green again (tests workflow)
notes: First red run: M4-09 (run 43504121800, commit that added test_budgeted_prewarm_equals_batch). Every later red run (M4-10, M6-13 x2, M3-28 test, M2-18, PUB, M0-22, PUB-01, P12-01/02, M4-01) failed on the same single test: tests/test_fast_lexicon.py::test_budgeted_prewarm_equals_batch[1e-05], assert seen. One green run in between (M3-28 pre-registration, 43537611850) shows it was flaky, not a constant break. Root cause: a timing-dependent test assert (10 us prewarm budget; slow CI runners never ran a prewarm step). The cause was fixed by M4-11 (eadab96, injectable clock, deterministic fake-clock tests); its run 43558817797 is green on all 4 jobs. No other failures: no data-path, optional-dependency, isolation-helper or TypeScript failures in any run. Extra fix: actions/setup-node v4 -> v6 (v4 ran on the deprecated node20 runtime; warning on every TypeScript job).
